content.short: Cornucopias 'The Island' is a massive Play-To-Earn Cardano blockchain based game.
content.description:
Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. Through the rise of blockchain technology users are empowered to Play-and-Earn, Build-and-Earn, Learn-and-Earn and Host-and-Earn using the utility token $COPI. The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items.

The game allows players to own vehicles, land, pets, mounts and other NFT (non-fungible tokens) based assets, tradeable in a peer-to-peer manner, all hosted in a fun and expanding Metaverse. Players will be immersed in the Play-and-Earn ecosystem where they can earn real-world value as they explore and build in our safe and secure world.

We genuinely care about every asset in our game. We know how to build fast, but we choose the slow route, because we want to deliver a high quality experience that will be engaging and is future proof.

We build every single asset in our game, from the grass to the clouds. This is not cheap and not easy. Cornucopias is Built Different.
